subject: Luka Modric
title: Croatia's 7-0 nightmare and Modric's suit

lines.vo: England beat Croatia seven-nil, and Modric was the captain.
He said losing was not the problem. The way they lost was. Seven goals is a lot of way.
Spain won two-one in Split, with Merino scoring twice. Croatia scored once. Progress.
Modric has six Champions League titles. Croatia's losing run was not impressed.
lines.footage: Modric Real Madrid Champions League lift archive

lines.vo: He gave Harry Kane a replica of the first football brought to Croatia. It dates from 1880. Seven-nil, and still giving gifts. Classy.
lines.footage: HNS replica ball presentation, Kane and Modric

lines.vo: Then, at forty-one, he played all ninety minutes as Milan beat Inter three-one. Redemption, Milan style.
Davor Suker says Modric would do a great job in Real Madrid's administration. Same club, smarter shoes.
lines.footage: Real Madrid boardroom exterior, neutral shot

inserts.story: A cartoon scoreboard flips to England 7, Croatia 0 and starts to smoke. A caricature Modric hands the scoreboard a tiny apology card. The scoreboard reads it, sniffs, and flips back to 0-0 out of pity.

inserts.story: A cartoon boardroom has a suit on a hanger labelled administration. A caricature Modric tries it on and it fits perfectly, except the shoes, which are football boots. He shrugs, and the pocket sticker reads still playing.

inserts.story: A cartoon stopwatch counts up to ninety while younger cartoon midfielders fall over like dominoes. A caricature Modric jogs on, then asks, is that all? He politely hands the stopwatch to the last tired rookie to hold.
